# kfilter containment policy (ABI 3)
#
# Start in audit mode. Run a full client session, review `kfilterctl watch`,
# and add one specific allow at a time. Do not flip to block until the only
# recorded would-denies are the intended ones.
#
# Rights are independent: execute means the loader may map the image; it does
# not grant FILE_READ_DATA. A deny with rights=read matches a mixed
# read+execute open, which closes the old data-only bypass.

mode audit
root C:\Nexon\Library\maplestorycw
appcontainer MapleStoryCW
# Every Nexon program, wherever it starts (unverified on Windows, 2026-11-08).
protect \nexon_launcher.exe
protect \nexon_client.exe
protect \nexon_agent.exe
protect \nexon_runtime.exe
protect \MapleStory.exe
protect \DwarfAxe.exe
protect \CrashReportClient.exe
protect \NGService.exe
protect \grap-core64.aes
protect \grap-updater.aes
protect \grap-communicator64.aes

block-files on
block-registry on
block-volume-serial on
block-process-memory on
block-process-create on
block-raw-disk on
block-network off
default-deny on
network-default deny
network-loopback on

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. The client's own tree and private state.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Nexon\Library\maplestorycw|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security|risk=anti-cheat-surface
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Local\Nexon|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Roaming\Nexon|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Local\D3DSCache|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Local\kfilter\Temp|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security
# The launcher's tree (its programs only) and NGService's (the service; the launcher installs it).
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Program Files (x86)\Nexon\Nexon Launcher|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security|image=nexon_*
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\ProgramData\Nexon\NGS|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security|image=NGService.exe|risk=anti-cheat-surface
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\ProgramData\Nexon|rights=read,write,execute,delete,rename,set-security|image=nexon_*

# Directory enumeration has its own rights. Deny sensitive Windows subtrees
# before the broad Windows directory allows.
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Prefetch
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\INF
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Temp
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Panther
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\config
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\winevt
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\LogFiles
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\Tasks
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Nexon\Library\maplestorycw|rights=enumerate,read,execute,write,delete,rename,set-security
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Local\Nexon|rights=enumerate,read,execute,write,delete,rename,set-security
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Roaming\Nexon|rights=enumerate,read,execute,write,delete,rename,set-security
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Local\D3DSCache|rights=enumerate,read,execute,write,delete,rename
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*\AppData\Local\kfilter\Temp|rights=enumerate,read,execute,write,delete,rename
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Program Files (x86)\Nexon\Nexon Launcher|rights=enumerate,read,execute,write,delete,rename|image=nexon_*
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\ProgramData\Nexon|rights=enumerate,read,execute,write,delete,rename
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows|rights=enumerate,read
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32|rights=enumerate,read
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\SysWOW64|rights=enumerate,read
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\WinSxS|rights=enumerate,read
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\DriverStore|rights=enumerate,read
allow|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Fonts|rights=enumerate,read
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Program Files
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Program Files (x86)
deny|dir|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Windows loader surface. Execute/map is allowed; raw reads are not.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Modules that exist to fetch host/security information. These must stay above
# the System32 execute allow so the image load is denied too.
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\wbem\wbemprox.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\wbem\fastprox.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\wbemcomn.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\wbemsvc.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\dxdiagn.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\wlanapi.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\dhcpcsvc.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\dhcpcsvc6.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\wtsapi32.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\netapi32.dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\*\pdh.dll

allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32|rights=execute|ext=dll|risk=windows-dll-surface
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\SysWOW64|rights=execute|ext=dll|risk=windows-dll-surface
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\WinSxS|rights=execute|ext=dll,mui|risk=windows-dll-surface
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Microsoft.NET|rights=execute|ext=dll
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\assembly|rights=execute|ext=dll
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\DriverStore|rights=execute|ext=dll
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Fonts|rights=read
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\catroot|rights=read
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\color|rights=read
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\en-US|rights=read|ext=mui
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\drivers\en-US|rights=read|ext=mui
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\C_*.NLS|rights=read
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\l_intl.nls|rights=read
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\locale.nls|rights=read
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts|rights=read

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Deny raw reads and identity-bearing OS data before the DLL execute allow.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32|rights=read|ext=dll
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\config
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\winevt
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\LogFiles
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\Tasks
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32|rights=read|ext=exe
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\System32\drivers|rights=read|ext=sys
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Prefetch
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\INF
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Temp
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Windows\Panther

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Other users, other volumes, network shares, devices and pipes.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Users\*|rights=read
deny|file|\Device\Mup
deny|file|\Device\CdRom*
deny|file|\Device\Floppy*
deny|file|\Device\Harddisk*
deny|file|\Device\Volume*
deny|file|\Device\PhysicalMemory
deny|file|\Device\MountPointManager

allow|pipe|\Device\NamedPipe\grap-core64*|rights=read,write,create,connect,listen
allow|pipe|\Device\NamedPipe\mojo.*|rights=read,write,create,connect,listen
deny|pipe|\Device\NamedPipe
deny|pipe|\Device\Mailslot

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Registry: own settings and the minimum runtime surface.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

allow|registry|\REGISTRY\USER\*\Software\Wizet|rights=read,write,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Wizet|rights=read,write,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\USER\*\Software\Nexon|rights=read,write,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Nexon|rights=read,write,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WinSock2|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Dnscache|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Nls|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation|rights=read,enumerate
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion|value=ProductId
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion|value=InstallDate
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion|value=RegisteredOwner
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\SideBySide|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\USER\*\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SystemCertificates|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\EnterpriseCertificates|rights=read,enumerate
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography\OID|rights=read,enumerate

# Audit-only compatibility candidates. They allow and record; convert to a
# narrow allow after a session proves the client needs them.
audit|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes\CLSID
audit|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes\Interface
audit|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsRuntime
audit|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AppModel

# Identity and inventory keys stay denied.
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Enum
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\HARDWARE
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\MMDevices
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\FolderDescriptions
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\UserAssist
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\RecentDocs
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\TypedPaths
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography|value=MachineGuid

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Child programs and network defaults.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

allow|process|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Nexon\Library\maplestorycw|rights=create
# The launcher starts its own programs (nexon_client, nexon_agent, nexon_runtime) from its tree.
allow|process|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Program Files (x86)\Nexon\Nexon Launcher|rights=create|image=nexon_*
deny|process|\Device\HarddiskVolume*
deny|process|\SystemRoot\*

# Driver IP filtering stays off until reviewed per-address allow rules exist.
# Generate a candidate fragment with tools/Install-NetworkPolicy.ps1, review it,
# then enable block-network with network-default deny. FQDN mediation is not implemented.
